title: Butterfly reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- book -->
  <polygon points='25,72 50,68 50,90 25,94' fill='#f5e6c8' stroke='#c9a86a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='50,68 75,72 75,94 50,90' fill='#f0d9b5' stroke='#c9a86a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#c9a86a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- pages lines -->
  <line x1='29' y1='76' x2='47' y2='73.5' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='29' y1='80' x2='47' y2='77.5' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='29' y1='84' x2='47' y2='81.5' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='73.5' x2='71' y2='76' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='77.5' x2='71' y2='80' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='81.5' x2='71' y2='84' stroke='#b8a070' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- butterfly body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='3.5' ry='12' fill='#4a3b8c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#5b4b9e'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M47,41 Q42,30 40,26' stroke='#6b5bae' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M53,41 Q58,30 60,26' stroke='#6b5bae' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='26' r='1.6' fill='#e8b84a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='26' r='1.6' fill='#e8b84a'/>
  <!-- wings left -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='44' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#8b5cf6' transform='rotate(-20 30 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='44' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#a78bfa' transform='rotate(-20 31 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='60' rx='10' ry='10' fill='#e879b9' transform='rotate(15 33 60)'/>
  <!-- wings right -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='44' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#8b5cf6' transform='rotate(20 70 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='44' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#a78bfa' transform='rotate(20 69 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='60' rx='10' ry='10' fill='#e879b9' transform='rotate(-15 67 60)'/>
  <!-- wing spots -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#fbbf24'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#fbbf24'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#f9a8d4'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#f9a8d4'/>
  <!-- eyes on head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#fbbf24'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#fbbf24'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M48,47 Q50,49 52,47' stroke='#fbbf24' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- little arms holding book -->
  <line x1='47' y1='58' x2='43' y2='68' stroke='#4a3b8c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='58' x2='57' y2='68' stroke='#4a3b8c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
